evidence.description: Before: compose_results.py has no reference to lanes anywhere; input metadata is not inspected beyond model routing, so an AEE result's lane pair is dropped on the floor.

falsification_tests: Compose a result set containing an AEE result with metadata.lanes and find no lane_states in the composed metadata, or find the lane pair altered from the input.
claims.text: Composition carries lane state through: a result whose metadata carries the lane pair produces a composed result whose metadata.lane_states names that evaluator and its lane pair verbatim, one entry per lanes-carrying evaluator.

evidence.description: Before: the composed summary reports evaluator outcomes and finding counts only; nothing in it can express that human acceptance lags machine verification.

falsification_tests: Compose a passing set whose AEE lane 2 shows claims below the explained stage and observe a composed summary that does not state the lag.
claims.text: The composed summary states lane-2 lag whenever a carried lane state shows it - claims below the explained stage, verified-but-unexplained claims, or residual not_understood entries - including when the composed outcome is pass.

boundary: scripts/python/compose_results.py outcome resolution and output shape

evidence.description: Verified by reading the outcome resolution: strategies resolve outcome strings by precedence/majority; no score arithmetic exists in composition today. The claim is that this remains true with lanes present.

falsification_tests: Find any composed output containing a numeric score derived from lane-2 state, or an averaged/blended lane figure.
claims.text: Composition never re-blends the lanes: outcome resolution stays strategy precedence over outcome strings, and no composed output contains a score computed from lane-2 state or any blended lane figure.

evidence.description: The pre-change behavior is the specification for lane-less inputs; the FR-6 suite pins it.

falsification_tests: Compose lane-less results after this change and find a lane_states key or a lane sentence that was not there before.
claims.text: Lane-less inputs compose exactly as before: no lane_states key and no lane language appears in a composed result built only from results that carry no lane data.
